title: recordCommandAnalytics
responsibility: Skips lookup-only CLI arguments and otherwise records command action, exit code, and elapsed time through the supplied or default analytics recorder.

inputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics.args
inputs.description: CLI argument strings are checked before recording; values recognized by skipsAnalytics suppress the event, and other values are passed to commandAction.

inputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics.startedAt
inputs.description: When analytics is not skipped, this millisecond timestamp is subtracted from Date.now() to produce durationMs; the function does not validate its range.

inputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics.exitCode
inputs.description: Accepts a number, string, null, or undefined, and is converted with Number(exitCode ?? 0) for the event; nullish values therefore become zero.

inputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics.record
inputs.description: Optional recorder called with the command event when analytics is not skipped; omitted input defaults to the imported recordAnalytics function. Its failure propagates through the returned promise.

outputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics
outputs.description: Resolves to void after the recorder finishes when analytics is not skipped, or immediately when skipsAnalytics(args) returns true.

errors.name: Propagated failure
errors.description: A throw from skipsAnalytics or commandAction, or a throw or rejection from the selected recorder, rejects this promise without being caught or transformed.
